input.command:
COMPANY_ID="9a7cf1f3-02a7-4751-9cdb-671c9c68edb5"
timeout 40 npx wrangler dev --no-bundle --local 2>&1 &
WRANGLER_PID=$!
sleep 8
echo "=== GET /api/companies/:id/agents ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID/agents" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'agents: {len(d)}')" 2>/dev/null
echo "=== GET /api/companies/$COMPANY_ID ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('name'), d.get('status'))" 2>/dev/null
echo "=== POST /api/auth/login (401 expected) ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:8787/api/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"test@test.com","password":"bad"}'
kill $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
